sources.note: Main website; describes RoyalCare as cloud-native RIS, highlights AI-powered workflows, patient engagement, revenue cycle management. Lists key modules: Royal Access, RoyalPay, RoyalMD, Royal AI.
Certifications page; lists Royal Solutions v5 ONC certification, PCI Level 1 compliance, HIPAA compliance. Mentions implementation costs are volume-based, interface setup fees for Direct Mail.
About page; founded 2008 by Peter Nassif, HQ White Plains NY, software in Nashville TN. Leadership team of 7 with 180+ years collective experience. No customer count or revenue disclosed.

Self-service care page; describes automated workflow solutions for patient/provider engagement through imaging lifecycle. Lists self-service registration, scheduling, cost estimates, payment, results delivery.
Royal Forms (CPOE) product page; SaaS electronic form submission with e-signature, PDF/XML/HL7 output, referral order processing, patient screening assessments, multilingual support.
Royal Professional managed services page; describes Royal Health Exchange (RHE) for secure data exchange, meaningful use attestation support, patient registration workflows.

RoyalCare RIS product page (redirected from info.royalsolutionsgroup.com/royal-ris); describes cloud-native end-to-end radiology platform with RIS, AI workflows, RCM, patient/provider engagement. Mentions 'coming January 2026' for new digital experience.

Press release about Radiology Ltd (US Radiology Specialists) deploying Royal Enterprise Care; replaced 7 separate systems with single platform. Covers ordering, medical records, scheduling, check-in, scanning, reading, report distribution.

PR Newswire release (2024) about LucidHealth selecting Royal Health for multi-state imaging centers. Single-vendor platform for patient/physician engagement, all-exam scheduling, mammography and lung tracking, billing, analytics.
PR Newswire release (2025) about Quinsite analytics partnership; integrating clinical, financial, and operational analytics into Royal platform via single sign-on.

Axis Imaging News article about Radiology Associates (Corpus Christi, TX) deploying Royal patient portal and kiosk; integrated with Merge RIS. Patients view reports/images, send secure messages, pre-register, pay bills.

Intermountain Medical Imaging blog post about launching Royal patient portal (2020); describes Royal Kiosk, Royal Alerts, Royal Pay for patient registration, notifications, insurance verification, and payment.

Healthcare Tech Outlook 2017 feature; describes Royal as 'top patient engagement solution company.' Lists Royal Kiosks, Patient Portal, Royal Pay. Mentions dual-layer encryption, cross-platform compatibility, patient record locking feature.
